matchedFields.content: What is Harissa paste? A warm & aromatic chilli paste with tomatoes and garlic - a staple flavour of Middle Eastern cuisine, originating from North Africa. Medium SpiceThere are so many exciting flavours and dishes to discover from across the Middle East. Why not release your adventurous side with Al'Fez Harissa Spice Paste. For a fantastic midweek meal, marinate 300g diced chicken breast in 2tbsp harissa paste mixed with 2tbsp natural yogurt. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes. Thread the chicken pieces onto the skewers and griddle over a medium heat for 10–15 minutes, or until cooked through. Garnish with finely chopped parsley and serve with Al‘Fez Moroccan Spiced Couscous. Welcome to our table.Suitable for vegetarians and vegans.Please recycle.At Al'Fez, our mission is to help everyone discover exciting, vibrant, frgarant flavours of the Middle East. DIRECTIONS: -Always supervise your child at brushing time. -Use only a smear of toothpaste up to the age of 3 years. -Aim to brush at least twice a day, for 2 minutes. -Encourage your little one to spit after brushing but do not rinse. -Store out of reach of little hands and do not allow your child to eat the toothpaste. -Dispose of if not used within 3 months.
matchedFields.title: preparationAndUsage

matchedFields.content: Brush-Baby Teething Toothpaste for Babies & Toddlers 0-2 years Applemint flavour, with soothing Camomile. Xylitol & Fluoride for strong teeth, healthy gums & fresh breath 50ml BABIES AND TODDLERS LOVE THE TASTE OF THIS TOOTHPASTE! An ideal first toothpaste or an alternative for little ones who are picky or don’t like minty flavours. Specially formulated for the teething stage, with a gentle applemint flavour that tiny tastebuds will love, plus camomile to soothe sore gums. The gentle fruity flavour and soothing formulation are the ideal way to encourage your little one if they are reluctant to brush! CREATE LOVELY SWEET-SMELLING KISSES! Suitable from birth, this toothpaste is rich in Xylitol - a natural ingredient which reduces sugar acids that can cause tooth decay, morning breath and dummy breath. The enamel of baby teeth tends to be thinner and needs extra protection. Brush-Baby Teething Toothpaste is lower in fluoride (500 ppmF) to help strengthen baby tooth enamel whilst being safer for your little one if swallowed. Just use a smear on a Brush-Baby manual, electric or Chewable toothbrush at brushing time. CONTAINS CAMOMILE FOR NATURAL RELIEF FROM TEETHING. Camomile is a natural anti-inflammatory which can help to soothe sore gums. Brush-Baby Teething toothpaste is also SLS-free and non-foaming, Paraben-free, Dairy-free, Cruelty-free, Glitter-free, Microbead-free, and suitable for Vegans and Vegetarians. The tube has a safety seal and an easy to open and close flip-top cap. Product packaging material is recyclable. GIVE YOUR CHILDREN’S TEETH THE BEST START. Suitable from 0 - 24 months. Oral care starts on day one and you should clean your newborn baby's mouth, gums and tongue every day. Keeping teething gums clean can help to avoid gum inflammation and pain during teething. When baby teeth start to come through, it’s important to brush from the first tooth. Cleaning your little one’s teeth twice a day with a toothbrush and a small amount of age-appropriate toothpaste helps remove bacteria, keep their mouth healthy and starts to get them used to the brushing routine. KEEPING YOUR LITTLE ONE'S SMILES HAPPY AND HEALTHY. Brush-Baby was inspired by a little girl who chewed her toothbrush! We know what it takes to give your babies, toddlers, young children and older kids the best start with their oral health and encourage them to develop healthy brushing habits.

Protect, style, volumise and add glass-like shine in one simple step with the FUL Styling Spray—a multifunctional mist that delivers heat defense, UV protection, and frizz control. Whether you're blow drying, curling or straightening, this spray shields strands from damage up to 200C while preserving hair health and shine. Designed to add volume, it lifts roots and adds body without the crunch. The lightweight formula smooths frizz, tames flyaways, and improves style longevity, even in humid conditions. Perfect for all hair types, including curly, dry, or colour-treated hair, this spray can be used on wet or dry strands to prep, protect, and perfect any look. Plus, its vegan formula ensures a clean styling experience, free from unnecessary weight or residue. From heat styling to everyday protection, the FUL Styling Spray helps your hair look and feel its best, effortlessly. matchedFields.content: Farfalle are bow-tie or butterfly shaped pasta. The name comes from the Italian word farfalla, meaning butterfly. Farfalle are formed from a rectangle or oval of pasta with two sides trimmed in a ruffled edge, and the centre pinched together to make the unusual shape. The pinched middle of farfalle helps keep them al dente when cooked and catches a little of the sauce. Farfalle are often served with light vegetable sauces as a summer pasta dish or in pasta salads. - Made in Italy - Durum Wheat Semolina Pasta - 14% Protein Pasta - Suitable for Vegan and Vegetarian Diets - Kosher certified - Egg Free

matchedFields.content: Penne are probably the most popular tubular pasta types around, The word Penne means "quills" and refers to straight tubes of pasta cut diagonally at the ends (like a quill pen). Rigate means "ridges" seen on the pasta and perfect for holding sauce. Penne makes excellent and versatile pasta for many applications because of the very practical design. The angle cut of the end makes a large surface area for sauce to fall into and be drawn up the tube which means they are great for pairing with thick tomato sauces, meat sauces, and chunky vegetable sauces - Made in Italy - Durum Wheat Semolina Pasta - 14% Protein Pasta - Bronze Drawn Pasta - Pasta Di Gragnano IGP - Suitable for Vegan and Vegetarian Diets - Kosher certified - Egg Free Garofalo pasta is formed through a bronze die, this method allows a little friction on the surface of the pasta, which becomes slightly rough and porous allowing the sauce to cling and be absorbed into the pasta giving a delightful eating experience

name: Kikkoman Gluten-Free Seasoned Sushi Rice Vinegar

matchedFields.content: Gluten Free, 100% Natural Ingredients, Suitable for Vegans, Versatile - use as an ingredient in sushi, dressings, dips, marinades
matchedFields.title: features

matchedFields.content: Making sushi rice has never been easier with Kikkoman Seasoning for Sushi Rice vinegar. To make perfect homemade sushi rice simply add 3 tbsp of Kikkoman Seasoning for Sushi Rice to 360 g hot cooked rice, mix well. Kikkoman Seasoning for Sushi Rice is milder than pure rice vinegar and with a lower acidity which is ideal for authentic sushi rice. It provides the right balance between sweet, salty, sour and umami. This special blend is also gluten-free and vegan, so no one has to miss out on the great taste. You can use it for all kinds of recipes, not just making sushi rice. Try in dressings for salads and poke bowls, add to marinades and bbq glazes, or use to season soups, dips and for pickles. Zero fat and just 25 kcals per tablespoon 100% natural ingredients Suitable for vegans and vegetarians Gluten-free The glass bottle and metal cap is fully recyclable Kikkoman Gluten-free Seasoning for Sushi Rice will keep for several months unopened in a cool, dark place. To preserve the flavour store the bottle in the fridge after opening. Best Before - see label. Recipe tips: - Make a gluten free stir fry sauce with 3 tbsp Kikkoman Tamari, 2-3 tsp chilli sauce and 1 tbsp Seasoning for Sushi Rice - Use to lightly pickle sliced cucumbers and radishes - Mix equal amount with Kikkoman soy sauce and sprinkle over roasted vegetables
matchedFields.title: detailedDescription

matchedFields.content: 100% natural ingredients Suitable for those with coeliac disease or a gluten allergy Gluten-free / wheat free Rich umami flavour Versatile – use for decorating sushi and many other dishes, or use as a glaze Suitable for vegans
matchedFields.title: features

matchedFields.content: Kikkoman Gluten Free Sushi Sauce is the perfect choice for sushi lovers. With its sweet-savoury flavour, gentle soy sauce aroma and glossy appearance, it easily gives a final flourish to your sushi rolls. Its thicker texture is ideal for decorating and garnishing sushi, yaki onigiri, bao buns and other dishes. The squeezy bottle design makes it easy to drizzle over rice, poke bowls and noodles – and it’s brilliant as a glaze for yakitori skewers, steaks and vegetables. 100% natural ingredients and gluten free. Suitable for vegans and vegetarians. GMO free. To preserve the flavour, keep the bottle in the fridge once opened.

name: Kikkoman Instant Miso Soup with Tofu

matchedFields.content: Kikkoman Instant Tofu Miso Soup makes a quick and delicious snack any time of the day. Simply tip the sachet into a bowl or mug, cover with hot water & stir! Made from red and white powdered miso, tofu, seaweed and spring onion, our miso soup makes a tasty and nutritious snack whenever hunger strikes. Each pack contains three convenient single-serve sachets for ultimate freshness and are easy to carry around with you in a bag or lunchbox. Suitable for vegans and vegetarians.

name: Kikkoman Japanese Sweet Mirin-Style Cooking Seasoning

matchedFields.content: Use as an ingredient in stir fries, dips, glazes and marinades, Low alcohol content, Suitable for vegans and vegetarians
matchedFields.title: features

matchedFields.content: Kikkoman Mirin-Fu is a sweet Japanese seasoning and glaze. Mirin-fu means Mirin-style in Japanese. Highly versatile, use Kikkoman Mirin-Fu to marinate and glaze your favourite foods, or use to flavour stir fry dishes, dips and even desserts. It's an essential ingredient for making the perfect homemade teriyaki sauce. Produced using Kikkoman's original fermentation technique, it also combines very well with other fermented seasonings such as soy sauce, miso and vinegar. Kikkoman Mirin-fu is much lower in alcohol (0.3%) compared with traditional Japanese Mirin rice wine, resulting in a much smoother taste and mild sweetness. 100% natural ingredients Suitable for vegans and vegetarians The glass bottle and metal cap is fully recyclable Kikkoman Mirin-fu Sweet Cooking Seasoning will keep for several months unopened in a cool, dark place. Best Before - see label. Recipe tips: - Make homemade teriyaki sauce with Kikkoman Mirin-fu, Kikkoman Soy Sauce, sake and sugar - Make a delicious nutty fusion dressing from Mirin-fu, olive oil, peanut butter and ponzu - Use to caramelise apples

matchedFields.content: Kikkoman Ramen Soup Base Shoyu is a convenient concentrated soup base featuring Kikkoman Soy Sauce for extra umami richness, allowing you to prepare a delicious shoyu (soy sauce) ramen in minutes. Ramen is a popular Japanese noodle dish. Simply dilute 2 tbsp of soup base with 270ml of boiling water, mix well. Add cooked ramen noodles and top with meat or vegetables of your choice. Be creative and customise your soup. Try other types of noodle such as soba or udon & use a variety of toppings - cooked ham, boiled eggs, carrots and chinese cabbage for instance. You can change up the broth flavour by adding miso or perhaps kimchi if you like a spicy taste. The possibilities are endless! Suitable for vegetarians & vegans The glass bottle is fully recyclable Kikkoman Ramen Soup Base will keep for several months unopened in a cool, dark place. To preserve the flavour store the bottle in the fridge after opening. Best Before - see label. Recipe tips: - Enjoy diluted in a mug of boiling water as a broth - Top your ramen with curls of smoked salmon or trout - Add sliced pan-fried duck as a ramen topping

matchedFields.content: This special set brings together two flavour-packed sauces from the masters of Asian flavours, Kikkoman. Inside you’ll find Kikkoman Wok Sauce with Roasted Garlic and Kikkoman Korean-Style BBQ Sauce — both crafted to deliver the savoury-sweet depth of teriyaki to your table in wonderfully easy ways. Plus it comes with a handy set of Kikkoman tea towels. Each sauce is made with a base of Kikkoman’s famed Naturally Brewed Soy Sauce, creating that unmistakable umami richness. They are suitable for vegans and vegetarians, making them a versatile addition to any kitchen. With its mellow garlic note and glossy finish, the Teriyaki Wok Sauce is the perfect stir-fry companion. Simply pour straight into a hot pan of meat, seafood, vegetables, rice or noodles and toss until beautifully coated. It also works brilliantly as a marinade or glaze — just brush onto pan-fried, baked, grilled or barbecued dishes as they cook to build irresistible flavour. The Korean-style BBQ Sauce is a fragrant fusion of Japanese teriyaki and the bold, fruity-spicy flavours loved in Korea. Infused with ginger, garlic, sesame oil and a hint of tangy apple, this velvety sauce transforms everyday dishes in moments. Use it as a dipping sauce for everything from sausages and chips to vegetable sticks, or as a marinade and glaze for barbecued meats, plant-based proteins and vegetables. Benefits: Two rich, flavourful teriyaki-inspired sauces in one beautifully giftable set Comes with practical tea towels Made with quality ingredients, GMO-free, and full of depth and character Ready to pour and enjoy — no extra seasoning needed Suitable for vegans and vegetarians

matchedFields.content: We know there are many great eco brands on the market but we are confident that ours still have the edge. Below are some of the points that makes ours unique compared to others available: Inclusivity – With the UK now being one of the most diverse societies in the world, we want to make our products convenient and embrace all ethnicities. As its not possible for products to include all languages on packaging we have found a way, with our new QR code we can share exciting new features and information and not just in English. Natural - We use high quality naturally derived ingredients in all Kinder by Nature products to create our mild but kind to skin formulation suitable for sensitive and eczema prone skin. We are very strict what goes into our formulation and believe we have the most natural formulation on the market as we refuse to use ingredients other brands still use to this day, such as: Alcohol / Parabens / Chlorine / SLS / SLES / Lanolin / Benzoates / Phthalates / Methylisothiazolinone / Propylene / Glycol / Phenoxyethanol / Triclosan / Benzalkonium chloride. Sustainability – As the 1st UK company to use a biodegradable wipe cloth we always want to be a step ahead of the trends which drove us to find a solution to our single use plastic to now using 100% recyclable packaging. Suitable for Newborns - Our baby wipes have been tested and approved suitable for newborns, as well as being dermatologically tested and Paediatrician approved. Vegan Friendly - With our natural formulation being derived from vegetable or plant extracts our’s are suitable for Vegans.

name: Naturtint Permanent Hair Colour Gel 10A Light Ash Blonde

matchedFields.content: "• Permanent Hair Colour with 100% grey coverage from the very first application, in a quick and easy to use, non-drip gel formula. • 92% naturally derived ingredients including plant and seed oils and extracts carefully chosen for their proven hair and scalp enhancing benefits. No ammonia, suitable for vegans. • Every box includes a 50ml Quinoa Multi-Care Mask to lock in your new colour and deeply nourish for several washes. Naturtint is committed to delivering naturally better hair colourants and has been at the forefront of reducing the amount of chemicals in hair colour and care, without compromising on results, for more than 30 years. An innovative and gentle permanent hair colour favoured the world over by consumers looking for softness and shine, as well as intense, natural-looking colour, Naturtint is the first hair colour to be USDA Certified Biobased. The USDA Certified Biobased Product label is a certification mark of the U.S. Department of Agriculture. Biobased products are derived from plants and other renewable agricultural, marine, and forestry materials. Biobased products are cost-comparative, readily available and perform as well or better than their petroleum-containing counterparts. Biobased products also help us increase our use of renewable resources while decreasing our use of non-renewable resources, such as petroleum. Naturtint Permanent Hair Colours exceed the minimum USDA certified biobased content for Hair Styling Products. Available in a variety of shades ranging from Ebony Black to Light Dawn Blonde, Naturtint Permanent Hair Colour Gels provide everything you need to colour, nourish, protect and care for your hair in one complete colouring treatment. Easy to follow instructions help you achieve long lasting, naturally radiant colour and shine in just 40 minutes, plus every box contains a 50ml tube of Quinoa Multi-Care Mask to use immediately after application and to maintain your colour in the weeks following, with enough for up to 4 applications. Got a question? Call us on 0345 601 8129 or email help@naturtint.co.uk. Whether you need a hand choosing the right shade or you want to know more about our formulations, we are delighted to be here to help. Looking for your gloves? You’ll find them attached to the instruction leaflet in each pack – we’ve done this to reduce the amount of plastic we use!"

matchedFields.content: Ocado Organic Oranges. Grown for their classic appearance and juicy flavour, oranges are a versatile and beloved citrus fruit. Their thick, unwaxed peel is suitable for vegans and the vibrant orange skin has a smooth texture and is full of aromatic oils. The juicy flesh inside is a beautiful bright orange, with easy-to-peel segments that are prized for their refreshing balance of sweetness and acidity. As 80g is 1 of your 5 a day, their segments are a delicious fruity snack to eat on their own. They are a classic addition to a fruit salad, adding a burst of sweet flavour and a beautiful colour. You can also press them for a glass of fresh orange juice to enjoy at breakfast or as a refreshing drink. The entire fruit can be used to add a vibrant flavour to both sweet and savoury dishes. The zest from the skin adds a punchy citrus note to cakes and biscuits, while a squeeze of the juice can be used to create delicious marinades and sauces for meat. They are also a staple for making classic jams, marmalades, and sweet desserts. Our organic oranges are grown to Soil Association organic standard farming methods, and avoid the use of unnatural pesticides and fertilisers. matchedFields.content: Ocado Organic Unwaxed Lemons. These juicy lemons are perfect for adding a zesty kick to your favourite dishes and drinks and with no wax coating, they're suitable for vegans and you can wash then grate or zest as needed. Their glossy yellow skin is famously aromatic, and their juicy, pale yellow flesh is prized for its strong, sour acidity and refreshing taste. If you do enjoy eating the whole fruit, a medium lemon (approx. 80g) is 1 of your 5 a day. Their powerful flavour makes them a key ingredient for adding a zesty lift to both sweet and savoury dishes. Use a squeeze of fresh lemon juice to cut through the richness of roasted meat or fish, or add a slice to drinks for a refreshing and fragrant garnish. They are a staple in marinades and dressings, adding a bright, tangy note to salads. Lemons are also ideal for a wide range of cooking and baking applications. Their juice and zest can be used to create classic desserts, such as a lemon tart or a zesty drizzle for cakes and biscuits. It also works well in other cuisines such as in a mezze platter with pita bread, vegetables, and other dips, or served alongside burgers and salads, sandwiches and wraps. HIGHLY RESEARCHED - Contains the world-renowned Bifidobacterium breve M-16V®, a high-quality probiotic strain researched in thousands of babies and young children in gold-standard clinical trials and used in over 140 baby care units across the globe. NATURAL & SAFE - These sugar-free, flavourless drops are free from artificial colours & preservatives and are specially formulated for use from birth onwards. EASY-TO-USE - A fuss-free friendly bacteria supplement in easy-to-administer liquid drops; directly into baby’s mouth, on a spoon or mixed into cool, non-acidic milk or food. VEGAN FRIENDLY - Suitable for vegans, vegetarians, and those on gluten-free, dairy-free & yeast-free diets. matchedFields.content: Transform your daily performance with our science-led 3-in-1 formula, featuring hydration, electrolytes, and essential vitamins. Our Phizz formula hydrates smarter, providing 3x faster hydration than water and 4 key electrolytes for peak physical and mental performance. Experience natural energy, immune support, and optimal wellbeing with our comprehensive multivitamin containing 18 essential nutrients. Our award-winning formula is trusted by professional athletes and backed by over 5,000 5-star reviews. Plus, our product is vegan, low calorie, Informed Sport tested, and uses natural flavours and colours. We're a sustainable brand that collects and recycles 1.5x the weight of plastic waste for each Phizz sold. When to use Phizz? Daily wellbeing, exercise, on-the-go (travel, flights, hot climates), busy days or after a big night out. How does Phizz work? 1. RAPID HYDRATION. Hydration is essential for everyday life but drinking enough water can be a challenge. Just 1-2% of dehydration can lead to fatigue, headaches, muscle cramps and concentration loss. Phizz is a hydration amplifier and helps you rehydrate 3 times faster than drinking water alone. 2. ELECTROLYTES. Electrolytes are VIPs at hydrating your body and contribute to brain, nerve, immune and muscle function, while also helping to prevent cramping and muscle fatigue. Phizz contains the 4 main electrolytes lost in sweat (sodium, potassium, chloride and magnesium), helping you put the good stuff back in. 3. HIGH DOSE MULTIVITAMIN. Phizz contains a broad range of 18 essential vitamins and minerals. This includes vitamins A, B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, B9, B12, C, E, sodium, potassium, chloride, magnesium, zinc, manganese and copper – to support natural energy, mental and physical performance, immune & brain function, recovery and wellness. SUSTAINABILITY. We believe in being kind to your body and our planet, that’s why we are plastic positive! This means for each tube of Phizz sold, 1.5x its weight in plastic is collected, recycled, and prevented from entering our oceans. Phizz tubes are recyclable, and our secondary packaging is recyclable card, made from recycled materials. Other benefits of Phizz include: • 2022 Men’s Health Sports Nutrition Award Winner • Informed Sport approved & batch-tested • Suitable for vegans • Suitable for vegetarians • Halal • Dairy, soy and gluten free • Natural colours & flavours • No caffeine • No aspartame • Low calorie • Better Hydration - Phizz hydrates you 3x faster than water alone thanks to its 7 key electrolytes, comprehensive multi vitamins and minerals., • Natural Energy - Phizz contains B vitamins to help promote energy release by the body and unlock its natural energy, reducing tiredness and fatigue., • Immune Support - Our high dose of vitamin C, zinc and other antioxidants help support your immune system, while a comprehensive multi vitamin with B vitamins give your energy levels a boost., • Brain and Muscle Function - Our multi-vitamin formula, minerals and electrolytes contribute to normal cognitive, nerve and muscle function, helping to increase your mental alertness and maximise your physical performance., • Suitable for Vegans - Our effervescent electrolyte tablets are vegetarian and vegan friendly., • Informed Sport Tested - Independently tested and verified.

name: Simple Kind To Skin Hydrating Light Moisturiser

matchedFields.content: Dry skin? Simple Kind to Skin Hydrating Light Moisturiser leaves dry skin feeling refreshed, soft and hydrated without clogging pores. Not only does this face moisturiser hydrate your skin instantly, it also provides up to 12 hours of moisturisation. Its fast-absorbing formula is enriched with Pro-Vitamins B5 and E, 1% Niacinamide and Bisabolol to help replenish and restore your skin’s barrier while leaving it softer, smoother and healthier looking. Dermatologically tested, hypoallergenic and non-comedogenic, our facial moisturiser contains no harsh chemicals, artificial perfume or colour, making it the perfect choice for sensitive skin. This skin care product is also suitable for vegans as Simple is PETA-Approved Vegan, meaning we don’t test on animals anywhere in the world. The bottle is made from 100% post-consumer recycled (PCR) plastic* and is 100% recyclable – please recycle (bottle is HDPE, cap is PP). To lock in hydration for soft skin, use this moisturiser in the morning and/or evening after cleansing with Simple Kind to Skin Moisturising Facial Wash and applying Simple Hyaluronic Acid + Vitamin B5 Booster Serum. Smooth it into your face and neck using upward and outward motions, and you’ll soon see how it starts to replenish and refresh your skin. *excluding cap and label

name: Simple Kind To Skin Micellar Cleansing Water

This face cleanser restores and soothes your skin with Pro-Vitamins B5, B3 and C, and uses triple-purified water to boost your skin’s hydration by 90%, helping your skin get through the day. It uses gentle Micelles to remove make-up, cleanse and unclog pores without greasy residue. Your skin will feel clean, fresh and instantly hydrated. Our Micellar Cleansing Water contains no harsh chemicals, artificial perfumes or colours, making it suitable for even the most sensitive skin. This facial cleanser is also suitable for vegans as Simple is PETA-Approved Vegan, meaning we don’t test on animals anywhere in the world. What's more, this bottle is made from 100% post-consumer recycled (PCR) plastic* and is 100% recyclable with its cap. Simple Kind to Skin Micellar Water is the perfect addition to your everyday routine, whether as a daily skin cleanser or gentle make-up remover. To use, apply a generous amount to a cotton pad. Wipe the pad all around your face; no need to rub. Avoid getting into eyes. No rinsing required. Discover the rest of our Simple Kind to Skin range to keep your skin soft, smooth and healthy looking. *excluding cap and label

name: Simple Kind to Skin Moisturising Facial Wash Gel

matchedFields.content: Supercharged with a vitamin-rich formula, Simple Kind to Skin Moisturising Facial Wash delivers the same gentle care you know and love from Simple, made even more effective for stronger, healthy-looking and smooth skin. This moisturising face cleanser gently washes away make-up and impurities without leaving your skin feeling tight or dry. Our dermatologically tested formula doesn't clog pores and contains no harsh chemicals, soap, alcohol, artificial perfume or colour, making it suitable for even the most sensitive skin. Enriched with skin-loving ingredients such as 2x Pro-Vitamins B5 and E and Pro Amino Acid Technology, this deep-cleansing, foaming gel-cream helps your skin become more resilient against damage with every cleanse. Our facial cleanser is also suitable for vegans as Simple is PETA-Approved Vegan, meaning we don't test on animals anywhere in the world. The tube is 100% recyclable - please recycle (tube is PE, cap is PP). name: Simple Water Boost Micellar Gel Wash Sensitive Skin

matchedFields.content: Simple Water Boost Micellar Gel Facial Wash is infused with advanced micelles and hydrating actives to deliver gentle yet effective cleansing and instant hydration – perfect for even the most sensitive skin.
